caption: The drawing features a rectangular decorative panel with a border and a central patterned area. The border is predominantly composed of swirling motifs in red, brown, gold, and blue, accented by floral shapes, and includes a rectangular blue inset at the top center, decorated with a red bow-like design. Inside the bordered area, the central composition depicts three potted plants, each with green leaves and various red, pink, and purple flowers. The vases or pots have different patterns and shapes: the left pot appears white with a crosshatch design, the center one is rounder and colored grayish with darker lines, and the right one is a plain white vessel. The background within the inner section is a light beige color with additional floral and leaf accents, featuring small birds and extra scattered blossoms in similar color tones as the main flowers. The overall color palette consists of reds, greens, browns, blues, beige, and hints of gold and purple, with black outlines emphasizing the shapes and forms within the composition. The number “233” is printed at the lower left of the page.
title: Plate 23: Painting on Buckskin, Laguna: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
